title: Cookie Policy
description: Cookies, local storage and optional analytics on the Car Key Supply website.
body:
The appointment form does not use cookies or local storage. The shop-location section includes an embedded Google Map, which may use cookies under Google’s own policies.

## Appointment requests

The appointment form prepares a text message on your device. It does not save your appointment details in cookies or local storage. You review and send the request in your own texting app.

## Google Maps

The shop-location section includes an embedded Google Map. When the map loads, your browser connects to Google, which can receive technical details such as your IP address and browser information and may use cookies. Google handles that information under its own privacy and cookie policies. The directions button opens Google Maps in a new tab.

## Browser settings

You can manage cookies and website storage in your browser settings. Your browser or hosting provider may maintain technical information associated with visiting a website.

## Updates

We will update this page if the website adds features that use cookies or browser storage.
